about_the_game:
After gaining remote access to the Plaza Pervium systems, your goal is to find out what preceded the chaos and reverse the lockdown.

Plaza Pervium is divided into 4 main areas which are further divided by sectors.

You'll have to get through multiple challenges throughout this place such as:

  • High temperature

  • Lack of light in some areas

  • Not getting lost

  • Finding resources for building and crafting

  • Radiation

  • Energy management

FIGHT

In order to further explore this place, you'll have to fight your way through now hostile machines. Use weapons to fight, melee or ranged. Set up traps and turrets to make your job easier.

BUILD

Different areas provide you with different types of resources, you will come across some completely unfamiliar materials. Use that to your advantage and build an outpost where you can rest, use traps and turrets to defend it, don't forget to put up a sound beacon or a beacon to not lose it!

ADVENTURE

How far can you get? The map uses a combination of procedural generation and carefully planed out spaces. Special areas, biomes and more await for you to explore them. It will be a long journey.

DEMO COMPARED TO THE FULL GAME

The demo only showcases a very small portion of the content that is intended to be within the full game. 
The full game is planned to have many more unique areas and more diverse interior categories and sub categories.

The full game is planned to also showcase more enemies and more lore and story content.

It is planned to also include more vehicles and highway related areas.

The full game is planned to introduce a segment system allowing you to modify the remotely controlled robot.

The full game is also planned to have a better progression based on how far you get in the game and it is planned to introduce a day/night cycle within Plaza Pervium.

WHAT IS WITHIN THE DEMO?

Within demo you are properly introduced to the game with two main starting tasks, related to the story. You are then left to roam and explore the seemingly endless procedurally generated map, you can build outposts, protect them from enemies, explore the first and second floor, produce gear and biofuel by setting please note that we plan to further improve the game loop for the full version.
